title: Vampire Vape Desserts Caramelised Banana Pancake Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Caramelised Banana Pancake Flavour Concentrate by Vampire Vape Desserts captures the rich taste of golden banana slices seared in syrupy sugar, layered over a warm, buttery pancake base. This sweet, breakfast-inspired flavour delivers smooth banana notes with caramelised glaze and subtle pastry undertones, making it an ideal concentrate for dessert lovers creating their own DIY e-liquids. This 30ml concentrate is designed for vapers who enjoy mixing their own e-liquids at home. Simply dilute with your preferred VG/PG base mix and, if required, nicotine shots to achieve your desired strength and consistency. Vampire Vape recommends a dilution rate of 15–20%, depending on personal flavour preference. Made in the UK and formulated with a 100% PG base, this flavour concentrate is not suitable for direct vaping. It must be mixed before use. Also available as a high-VG Shortfill and in Freebase 10ml format as part of the Vampire Vape Desserts collection. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is for mixing your own e-liquid and is not suitable for direct vaping or commercial use.
